title: Voice Changer
description: ⚠️Voice Changer For Simple Voice Chat Mod! is a clean and lightweight mod that adds fun voice-changing features to your Minecraft voice chat experience. It is designed to work smoothly with Simple Voice Chat. WARNING! REQUIRES SIMPLE VOCE CHAT MOD!
body:
![voicelogo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5dcb9ba3098f3747790d1b36beca0c00f4d02049.png)

Simple Voice Changer is a clean and lightweight mod that adds fun voice-changing features to your Minecraft voice chat experience. It works with Simple Voice Chat, making it easy to change how your voice sounds while playing with friends. 🎧✨

Perfect for SMPs, roleplay, trolling friends, events, and funny server moments. 😄🔥

# ✨ Features

🎧 It is lightweight, easy to use, and proudly made as THE FIRST EVER VOICE CHANGER MOD! ⚡ Perfect for roleplay, SMPs, multiplayer fun, and funny moments with friends. 🎭👥 It keeps everything clean with no unnecessary extra features. 🧼

###  NEW SOUNDBOARD ADDED WITH COOL SOUNDS V2

# 📦 Requires

🎙️ Simple Voice Chat                                                  
# ⚠️ Note

This mod will not work without Simple Voice Chat installed.
